slides.title:
Automation coverage
is the *wrong metric*.
slides.body: It measures how much you built.

slides.title: Everyone reports it
slides.body:
Because it's the one
you can compute.

slides.title: The number climbs
slides.body:
Sixty percent of provisioning.
Forty percent of compliance checks.
Every quarter, a little higher.

slides.title: The trap
slides.body:
Ninety percent coverage on the
tasks that were never
the *bottleneck*.

slides.title: The metric that holds
slides.body:
Time-to-safe-change.
From "we decided" to "it's live,
verified and *revertible*."

slides.title: Including the waiting
slides.body:
Script runs in four seconds.
Board meets Thursdays.
Your number is *a week*.

slides.title: Why it travels
slides.body:
A CFO can't read "60% coverage."
They can read "nine days
down to *one*."

slides.title: How to use it
steps: The average hides the one that takes three weeks.

slides.title:
Coverage says how
much you built.
